description: Figure 3, titled "Results of Ablation Study," presents a comparative analysis of the performance of the proposed DAE model on two datasets, PHME and PolitiFact, under different experimental conditions. The figure consists of two grouped bar charts, one for each dataset, with the y-axis representing "Accuracy (%)" on a scale from 75.0 to 95.0. The x-axis for each chart displays five different ablation settings, which are labeled as "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," and "w/o emotion." The "Ours" setting represents the full model, while the other labels indicate the model with a specific component removed. For the PHME dataset, the bar for "Ours" reaches 89.84%, while the removal of "comments" (w/o comments) results in a significant drop to 86.82%, and the removal of "text" (w/o text) leads to a drop to 80.10%. For the PolitiFact dataset, the "Ours" model achieves an accuracy of 90.57%, which decreases to 85.85% when "comments" are removed and to 83.02% when "text" is removed. The chart uses a consistent color scheme: a dark red for the "Ours" bar, an orange for "w/o comments," a light blue for "w/o text," a medium blue for "w/o select," and a light green for "w/o emotion." The results clearly show that the removal of tweet text and reader comments leads to the largest drops in accuracy, indicating their fundamental importance to the model's performance.
